notes: Profit Concentration Policy (not a classic consistency rule): 'If a single trade idea accounts for more than 60% of the profit target in an evaluation phase, the Master Account created after passing will require 4 minimum profitable days before each reward can be requested.' Striking System: warning at 1% floating loss on one trade idea; 2nd warning halves split to 42.5%, 3rd drops to 20%, 4th closes the account.
Minimum reward request is 1% of account size.
Inactivity breach after 30 consecutive days with no completed trade.

profitSplitPct and payoutFrequency left null deliberately: there is no single value. Four selectable cycles, each with its own split - On Demand 90% (requires 35% consistency score and min 2% profit), Weekly 60% (7 days after first executed trade), Bi-Weekly 80% (every 14 calendar days), Monthly 100% (every 30 calendar days). Do NOT quote a single headline split for this product.
The 35% consistency rule applies ONLY to the On Demand cycle, not to the Weekly/Bi-Weekly/Monthly cycles or to the evaluation phases.
Risk Per Trade Idea rule has been REMOVED on 2 Step Standard.
Striking System (4 warnings) applies to Master Accounts above $25,000.
Legacy note from the page: 'Existing 2 Step Standard accounts with a 10% profit target will reset as 2 Step Flex' - the current Phase 1 target is 8%, not the older 10%.

maxLossPct of 5% is a TRAILING limit on peak equity, not a static floor - it is not comparable like-for-like with the 6-12% static limits on the evaluation models. It locks at the starting account size once equity reaches 5% profit.
Max Open Risk Limit 1%: 'Floating PnL cannot exceed -1% of the starting account size at any time' - hard breach.
Risk Per Trade Idea: 3% below $50K, 2% at $50K and above.
Min Profitable Days: at least 7 profitable days (0.25%+ each) per rolling 30-day period - failing this is listed under hard breaches.

Reward eligibility needs all four of: consistency score <=15%, 7 profitable days in the rolling 30-day period, a 3% safety cushion (first 3% profit not eligible for reward), and biggest losing day not exceeding biggest winning day.
Reset available at a 20% discount for all account sizes.
